primaryPredictor: same-vintage log(SA unfilled orders current reference month / prior month)
primaryTarget: mean first-FULL-M3-report within-vintage monthly SA shipment log change across the THREE full calendar months after each forecast cutoff month; nominal business activity, NOT real production or stock returns
industryScope: fixed six order-taking durable-goods publication groups; numeric NAICS IDs and vintage equivalence REQUIRE original documentation, not guessed from names; no favourable subgroup selection
evaluationCutoffMonths: 2009-01..2025-12, Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct only (68 fixed non-overlapping future three-month windows)
forecastCutoff: 23:59:59 America/New_York on final calendar day of each fixed cutoff month; use latest FULL M3 report actually released strictly before cutoff; keep actual reference-month lag
baseline: fixed historical persistence: mean of last three source-eligible first-full monthly shipment log changes, forecast unchanged for next three complete calendar months
candidate: baseline + beta * primaryPredictor; ONE common beta, no intercept, no clipping or tuning; expanding past-only OLS on residuals using only targets whose complete three-month first-full outcomes were already published before cutoff; >=60 prior fully complete monthly training origins, paired same-input mask
inference: ONE primary equal-industry-weight paired squared-error improvement averaged within each fixed calendar cutoff. Compare common six-industry panel with >=60 complete non-overlapping time blocks; never count industries as independent time replications. One-sided alpha .05 candidate, 80% power target; dependence-robust time-block inference must be independently reviewed before registration.
missingness: missing original full release/date/table cells, suppressed/nonnumeric/nonpositive levels, taxonomy uncertainty, late publication or missing training outcome => BLOCKED/UNKNOWN; no fill, revised-series fallback, synthetic vintage, or dropping hard industries. >=60 complete six-group fixed blocks required.
vintage: first FULL M3 publication vintage, which can already revise the earlier advance durable-goods release; never call it earliest advance vintage. Read current/prior columns only WITHIN a fixed source release; do not splice newly benchmarked levels to earlier vintages. As-released monthly changes define target rather than final revised growth.
stop: NO_GO if any mandatory rights/PIT/taxonomy/source gate unresolved or fixed support insufficient. Do not change series, horizon, dates, groups or target after viewing outcomes.
